source.name: strict 200 multi-trajectory nozzle ablation
source.input: health = 1 - normalized_depth, normalized per source trajectory
source.pretraining_selection: source validation only; source test audit only

rw_proxy.target: FEMTO mechanical degradation proxy, ordinal remaining measurements
rw_proxy.rms_calibration: fine-tuning training-prefix RMS only; no holdout or full-life min/max

model.main_transfer: pretrained encoder, target projection, and head all fine-tuned

fairness.early_stopping: same chronological validation for transfer, scratch, and frozen ablation
fairness.trial_selection: SHA-256-derived explicit seed, not Python hash()

battery.target_input: causal capacity damage = 1 - SOH; transform maps damage back to health

rw_proxy.target_label: ordinal remaining measurements within complete FEMTO Learning_set run

integrity_checks.hashes: SHA-256 recorded; re-run compares to this manifest before resume

battery.rule: each domain is judged separately; any failure remains diagnostic rather than a success claim

rw_proxy.rule: each domain is judged separately; any failure remains diagnostic rather than a success claim

positive_claim_rule: Only domains/N-shot settings meeting every stated acceptance condition are positive evidence.
